title: Deploy policies
description: Guardrails checked before every deploy, at organization, project and environment scope. The most specific scope wins per rule.
notConfigured: Deploy policies are not available on this control plane.
rootOnly: Only instance admins can change deploy policies. You can still run a dry run.

allowed_registries.title: Allowed image registries
allowed_registries.hint: Comma separated hosts, for example ghcr.io, docker.io.

require_readiness_probe.title: Require a readiness probe
require_readiness_probe.hint: Apps must define a readiness probe before they deploy.

max_memory_mb.title: Memory ceiling (MB)
max_memory_mb.hint: An app with no memory limit exceeds the ceiling.

max_cpu.title: CPU ceiling (cores)
max_cpu.hint: An app with no CPU limit exceeds the ceiling.

forbid_privileged.title: Forbid privileged containers
forbid_privileged.hint: Blocks apps that ask for privileged mode.

forbid_host_mounts.title: Forbid host bind mounts
forbid_host_mounts.hint: Optional comma separated path prefixes that stay allowed.

required_labels.title: Required labels
required_labels.hint: Comma separated label keys every app must set.

max_replicas.title: Replica ceiling
max_replicas.hint: Most replicas one app may run.

dryRunHint: Previews the rules above without saving them.

stored.title: Saved policies
stored.empty: No policies yet. Add a rule above and save it, or run a dry run first to see what would fail.

result.summary: {{checked}} apps checked, {{failing}} would be blocked, {{warning}} with warnings.

errors.idRequired: Enter the project or environment id for this scope.
